view.scene_description: The image depicts an indoor space, likely a modern cafe or restaurant. The room features large windows on the left side, allowing natural light to flood in and creating a bright atmosphere. A tall cylindrical structure with a purple base and white spiral design is visible in the background, adding a unique architectural element to the space. The floor appears to be made of polished marble, reflecting the light from above. There are several tables and chairs arranged throughout the room, some occupied by people who seem to be working or studying. A red wall on the right side of the image adds a pop of color to the scene. The overall ambiance suggests a comfortable and inviting environment for relaxation or work.

objects.label: Large windows
objects.observation: The windows are located on the left side of the room, spanning almost the entire height of the wall. They allow ample natural light to enter the space, creating a bright and airy atmosphere. The windows appear to be made of clear glass, which contributes to the open feel of the room.

objects.label: Tall cylindrical structure
objects.observation: This distinctive feature is situated in the background, behind the tables and chairs. It has a purple base and a white spiral design that spirals upwards, resembling a modern art installation or architectural feature. The structure adds visual interest and a sense of grandeur to the room.

objects.label: Polished marble floor
objects.observation: The floor is covered in polished marble tiles, which reflect the light from above and create a glossy surface. This choice of flooring adds to the upscale and sophisticated feel of the space.

objects.label: Tables and chairs
objects.observation: Several tables and chairs are scattered throughout the room, providing seating options for patrons. Some tables have laptops and other items on them, suggesting that this space might be used for work or study as well as dining. The chairs appear to be modern and comfortable, complementing the overall aesthetic of the room.

objects.label: Red wall
objects.observation: A prominent red wall is visible on the right side of the image. The wall's vibrant color stands out against the more neutral tones of the rest of the room, adding a bold accent to the space.

view.extraction: 2 literal JSON document(s) for display only; 100 trailing characters retained in raw

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000001", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
